attchmntText: Monitoring Agency Report of Turtlemint Fintech Solutions Limited for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, on the utlization of proceeds raised through issuance of equity shares by way of public issue of the Company.
voiceSummary: Turtlemint Fintech Solutions Limited filed the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, with BSE and NSE. The report, issued by Care Ratings Limited, confirms no deviation from IPO objects for the Rs.660.72 crore issue. Funds were utilized for cloud infrastructure, salaries, marketing, lease payments, subsidiary funding, and general corporate purposes. Fixed deposits of Rs.65 crore were created from the monitoring account. The company reported operating and net losses. IRDAI released a consultation paper on September 24, 2026, regarding insurance distribution economics, which may impact commission income. Share price volatility was attributed to this proposal. The Audit Committee and Board approved the report on November 12, 2026.

attchmntText: Turtlemint Fintech Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 12, 2026, titled "Press Release on Unaudited Financial Results (Standalone and Consolidated) of the Company for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026"
voiceSummary: Turtlemint Fintech Solutions Limited filed a press release with BSE and NSE regarding its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Platform premium grew 55% year-on-year to INR 1,214 crore in Q2 FY27. Revenue from operations increased 35% to INR 342 crore. Service EBITDA rose 47% to INR 45 crore. Adjusted EBITDA as a percentage of revenue improved from minus 14% to minus 6%. Corporate overheads as a percentage of revenue declined from 26% to 19%. For the half year, platform premium grew 52% to INR 2,419 crore. Revenue from operations grew 38% to INR 637 crore. Service EBITDA increased 66% to INR 85 crore. Renewal revenue grew by 52%. The results are available on the company website.

attchmntText: Turtlemint Fintech Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Turtlemint Fintech Solutions Limited filed an investor presentation regarding its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported revenue from operations of INR 637 Cr for H1FY27, reflecting 38% year-on-year growth. Service EBITDA stood at INR 85 Cr, up 66% year-on-year. Adjusted EBITDA improved to minus INR 48 Cr from minus INR 77 Cr in the prior period. Profit after tax was minus INR 64 Cr, compared to minus INR 125 Cr previously. The platform premium reached INR 2,419 Cr. The company recruited over 69,000 digital partners in H1FY27, bringing the total base to 7,28,138. Corporate overheads reduced to 21% of revenue from 28% in the prior year. The presentation is available on the company website.

voiceSummary: Turtlemint Fintech Solutions Limited approved its Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board meeting was held on November 12, 2026. The results include a net loss of 33.23 for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, compared to a loss of 35.55 in the previous quarter. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, the net loss was 68.78. Revenue from operations stood at 15.83 for the quarter. Total income was 24.85 for the quarter. Total expenses amounted to 58.08 for the quarter. The statutory auditors, S.R. Batliboi & Co. LLP, issued a limited review report on the financial results. The paid-up equity share capital is 29.
